situation: I need to screen EU locations for a data center against a specific MW load and gCO₂/kWh ceiling, and today I face 1–2 days on ENTSO-E pulling 20+ country files plus a half-day on Ember — all producing country averages that mask the zone-level variation where the DC will actually be located
motivation: run a single query that applies the carbon ceiling as a hard filter at zone level and ranks EU NUTS2 zones by energy cost, grid headroom, and connectivity in one unified output
outcome: produce a defensible shortlist in hours instead of weeks without stitching mismatched country-level datasets in Excel
quantified_pain: 8–24 hours mechanical data wrangling (S2+S3 combined); country-level granularity on decisions worth €100M–€1.7B over asset life

situation: I have built a site ranking with manually assigned weights and no audit trail, and I am about to present it to an investment committee who may challenge the data source, recency, or scoring methodology
motivation: have every score cite a traceable source (PyPSA-Eur, Ember, OSM) with a published weighting methodology and a per-dimension breakdown that shows exactly why Site A ranks above Site B
outcome: walk into the IC meeting with genuine confidence — not anxiety about being caught defending a spreadsheet built on judgment — and have the recommendation stand without being sent back for rework
quantified_pain: IC deferral adds 1–3 analyst days (€600–€1,700) and a 2-week delay; worst case restarts analysis from S2

situation: Jordan's analysis flags that a zone has high PPA curtailment opportunity but cannot quantify the discount — PPA prices are bilateral and structurally non-public — so the flag appears in the deck without a number I can model
motivation: see the PPA discount expressed as €/MWh at each flagged zone relative to day-ahead spot and the NPV of that discount over the contract term at our target MW
outcome: quantify the financial value of the PPA-opportunity site over the grid-heavy alternative, plug the delta into our DCF model, and give the CEO a financially grounded recommendation — not a flag that the committee cannot act on
quantified_pain: PPA price transparency structurally low (Pexapark 2026); without zone-level LCOE output IC cannot distinguish a 15% discount opportunity from a marginal one

situation: My team brings me an EU expansion analysis — but it is a spreadsheet with trade-offs buried in an appendix, two versions of the numbers that Jordan and the CFO are not yet aligned on, and no clear winner
motivation: receive one ranked recommendation with a plain carbon compliance story and a financial delta — something I can read in five minutes and act on
outcome: make the go/no-go call without needing to understand grid physics, walk into the board with a defensible strategic rationale, and know that Jordan and the CFO are citing the same numbers
quantified_pain: Current output: 80-page consultant report or a misaligned CEO deck + CFO Excel. CEO quote: 'I don't need to understand the grid. I need to know which country we're going into and whether we'll be able to say we're running on clean energy.'
